results.hubText: YOUR DIGITAL HOME BASEAttendee Hub.The Attendee Hub is your central resource for all event-related information. Through the Hub, you can review key dates and deliverables, submit your Attendee Profile questionnaire and hotel requirements, build your personalized itinerary, and access important event information and resources.Attendee Hub login credentials are provided by your Operations Lead in their welcome email, which is typically sent 8–10 weeks before the event start date.Placeholder — Delegate MeetMax destination pending Operations confirmation. The email link below contacts Operations; it does not open MeetMax.‍EMAIL OPERATIONS

YOUR DIGITAL HOME BASESponsor Hub.The Sponsor Hub is the central resource for managing your organization’s participation in the event. Through the Hub, you can submit a custom Delegate Profiling Question, update your company information, register your onsite attendees, complete the business meeting selection process, review key dates and deliverables, and access important event information and resources.Sponsor Hub login credentials are provided by your Operations Lead in their welcome email, which is typically sent 8–10 weeks prior to the event start date.Placeholder — Sponsor MeetMax destination pending Operations confirmationOPEN SPONSOR HUB
